8.1. iLock_Geography¶

This module contains a general framework for dealing with railyards having the IRailyard interface (as defined in Prover iLock). More specifically it contains functionality for

  • searching and calculating (iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms),
  • defining and using types (iLock_Geography.geo_type, iLock_Geography.type_manager),
  • defining and using geographical predicates, i.e. python objects that behave as logical predicates (iLock_Geography.geo_predicate, iLock_Geography.predicate_manager), and
  • mapping IRailyard instances and geo predicates onto PiSPEC instances and predicates (iLock_Geography.geo2pispec).
  • Using LMC configuraton files to generate PiSPEC instances and configure parameters (iLock_Geography.lcf.api).

It contains a library of geo_predicates (iLock_Geography.predicate_library), of which some are pre-configured for direct use (iLock_Geography.builtins).

It also contains various utilities, etc.
